Austin’s housing supply includes the homes we already have.

On October 8, the Austin Housing Finance Corporation approved support for the acquisition and rehabilitation of Elm Ridge Apartments at 1190 Airport Boulevard.

City project documents identify 130 existing apartments: 68 one-bedroom, 48 two-bedroom and 14 three-bedroom units. The proposed rehabilitation keeps the focus on existing income-restricted housing, rather than adding 130 new homes.

The approval authorizes up to $33 million in multifamily housing revenue bonds for the transaction. That is a financing authorization—not a report that renovations are complete.

Why it matters locally: Preserving and repairing existing apartments is another way to maintain Austin’s housing options alongside new construction.

The October 8 approval does not establish a renovation completion date or confirm units available for rent. Prospective residents should verify availability and current eligibility requirements directly with the property.

Source: City of Austin, October 8, 2026—AHFC agenda, project backup and meeting transcript.
